title: How To Read Literature Like A Professor

questions.q: Which three things does the summary say hide a book's deeper message?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says readers should watch for memory, symbols and recurring patterns.

questions.q: What are the five parts of the quest structure?
a: Quester, destination, reason, challenges and revelation
Hero, villain, helper, treasure and return
Beginning, conflict, climax, twist and ending
Departure, initiation, return, reward and marriage
questions.why: Lesson 2 lists a quester, a destination, a stated reason, obstacles and an unexpected revelation.

questions.q: In the Alchemist example, what does Santiago discover at the end?
a: The treasure was right where he started
The pyramids contained no treasure at all
He must remain in Egypt forever
His dream was only a warning
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the unexpected revelation shows the treasure had been in front of him all along.

a: All texts depend on one another
questions.why: Lesson 3 defines intertextuality as the way every text draws on earlier texts.

questions.q: What does a storm on the horizon usually symbolize?
questions.why: Lesson 3 gives the storm as a recurring symbol for trouble, whether real or a plot twist.
